breakdown.description: It first gives the n = 2 form of the growth law, but later says to use n = 3. The exponent must be specified consistently.
breakdown.reason: The ground truth uses n = 2 (D² - D₀² = Kt) consistently throughout. The generated specification instead chose to use n = 3, repeating the incorrect exponent from the flawed incomplete prompt rather than resolving it to match the ground truth's n = 2 formulation. The agent should have used D² - D₀² = Kt and computed K = (30² - 12²) / 1 = (900 - 144) = 756 μm² h⁻¹.
